title: VTC Registry Sync Jobs Discard — payload
description: Delete an abandoned trust-registry reconciliation job without dispatching it. The registry's record for that member is left exactly as it is.

jobId.description: The job to delete, from `vtc/registry/sync-jobs/list`. Required and single: discard is irreversible, so there is deliberately no bulk form.

Response.title: VTC Registry Sync Jobs Discard — response payload

memberDid.description: The member whose pending change was dropped. Returned because the caller is discarding by identifier and this names what it actually cost.
